New Zealand's Arbitr gives execs multilingual voice, accelerates disclosures

David Sowerby, co-CEO of Arbitr Group, says traditional dubbing has not always captured a speaker's passion and nuance. (Photo by Minako Yamashita)

TOKYO -- A New Zealand investor information services provider has developed a dubbing service using artificial intelligence that instantly translates videos of company executives into multiple languages.
